o: After a dance-team initiation goes awry, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

eps.o: After dance team hopefuls Lisbeth and Grace audition for an open spot, the squad initiates their new teammate in a hell-raising Halloween ritual.
Haunted by a guilty conscience, Anya tries to limit the fallout from Halloween night. Lisbeth exploits an opportunity to rise above her social status.
Unsettling dreams shake the Lions' team spirit. Suspicion falls on a guilt-stricken Leo after his drawing of Grace makes the rounds at school.

eps.t: I Saw Grace Franklin with the Devil
eps.o: As visions of Grace spread, Anya tries a hands-on approach to managing her anxiety. Elise leverages Leo's innocence to infiltrate Lisbeth's home life.
The Lions head to the country to prep for regionals, but when they try to save Grace by exorcising their demons, the weekend spirals into unholy chaos.
Sidelined at regionals by a miraculous recovery, Lisbeth preys on a teammate's weakness. An electric performance reignites Anya and Elise's connection.
Lisbeth copes with a change in circumstances. Steven makes a disturbing discovery. A shocking confession tests Father Franklin's limits.
Sinful secrets threaten to tear Anya's world apart as Father Franklin chases answers, Elise demands the truth and Lisbeth makes a cunning Hail Mary move.
